english.title: Proprietor of PHV employing unlicensed driver - outside London
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the proprietor of a private hire vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), licensed under Part II of the Local Government (Miscellaneous Provisions) Act 1976, employed as the driver thereof for the purpose of any hiring a person, namely **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), who did not have a current licence under section 51 of the Act
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 46(1)(c) and (2) and 76 of the Local Government (Miscellaneous Provisions) Act 1976.
